description: She wears an opaque plum brown floor length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow length sleeves. Gold woven borders edge the neckline, sleeves, waist and front skirt panels. A cream shoulder wrap with matching borders rests loosely around her forearms and hangs down both sides. A decorated belt with round gold details gathers the waist. Her hands rest together in front; the skirt covers the legs with a narrow walking opening near the shoes. Brown decorated shoes appear beneath the hem, and her head is bare.
